verdicts.reason: Both use the same sensible vertical restack. In both, the circle bleeds off the right edge as in the original, but the product can is small and floats off-centre. The 'Ends Sunday' fine print is set almost as large as the subhead, and the wrapped 'off' and 'case.' leave the copy feeling chopped. A spaces the subhead, CTA and product a little more evenly. B pushes everything upward, so the CTA sits close to the circle and leaves a larger dead gap between the can and the footer.
